local_source_notes.source_meaning_and_boundary: Both Yes/No authorized indications share Response SUCCESS; successful determination ≠ granted permission or successful command.
Authorization failure/unavailability uses effective policy; source example may authorize none or all, no universal default.
Maintain Config/Status only if sufficient computing resources; do not assert unlimited cache.
DEVICE REMOVED clears maintained Config/Status, not original historical observation records.
Discover success includes zero matches; returned state comes from maintained Config/Status and requested projection.
H-0002 prints Parent Requirements before four subordinate M requirements; literal source label preserved.
Creator/requester and subscriber/consumer can differ; unique subscription identifier returned with SUCCESS.
Creator-registration subscription maintenance and consumer-removal cleanup are distinct source scopes.
On subscription creation send maintained matching Config/Status; these are not a historical Event cache.
Status changes and Event detector properties can alter match; Event properties are not Status reports.
START FOLLOWING and STOP FOLLOWING are Administrative to consumer; no receipt guaranteed by source.
Printed parent M-0010 Forward Matched Messages retained, despite surrounding M-0009 matching-change context.
Printed Start Matching title, 'now matched' condition and STOP FOLLOWING code coexist; not silently repaired.
Event and Administrative matching/forwarding to consumer does not prove performed Observation or source authentication.
101 distinct L-level mappings, 95 Test and six Inspection; Analysis/Demonstration defined but unused.
18 acronyms, including CCD=Component Capability Description, not new DIM fields.
